known_uncertainty.summary: Review by a qualified civil-appellate and Virginia contract practitioner remains pending; no independent review is recorded and no level-3 claim is made.
Automated schema, citation, deadline, and replay checks do not establish the legal accuracy, completeness, currency, or practical realism of the cited authorities or authored analysis.
Operation bindings, record tags, and classifications are authored for the exact identified documents and do not generalize to novel filings, altered bytes, or unreviewed procedural circumstances.

The notice and separate-document clocks depend on authored finality predicates; the system replays those exact branches but does not infer finality or select a trigger from arbitrary district records.

The separately docketed branch pages are counterfactual training artifacts that never occurred on the actual district or appellate dockets and must remain isolated from actual-history questions and grounding.

The bench profiles and oral-argument behavior are synthetic training constructs; differentiation and deterministic replay do not model any real judge or predict actual advocacy, questioning, or outcomes.

The PDFs are generated training artifacts. Source-to-PDF checks, accepted render inventories, and pinned hashes document repository provenance but cannot establish external authenticity, cross-render byte determinism, or complete accessibility and typography quality.

The supported-certification branch binds its changed district predicate and resulting opinion, judgment, release, and mandate, but abstracts intervening notice, docketing, and briefing papers that were not authored for that counterfactual docket; replay therefore verifies the modeled branch consequence rather than a complete counterfactual appellate docket.
